A smart-shotty modified into a quasi close-range rocket launcher that tears everything in its blast radius to shreds. The perfect arsenal for a one-borg army.

Category: Super Luxury • Fabrication: Leave the slaughterhouse alive. (Cannot be Fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged from Adam Smasher)

Class: Iconic EQ Shotgun • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Long Barrel Shotgun

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 16 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Shotgun Shell (5d6)

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Shotgun Choke, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified Improved Smart Ammunition (100eb [Premium] per 16 rounds) that also functions as Armor-Piercing, Incendiary, and Explosive Ammunition (Still has its Attack Check penalty and inability to make Aimed Shots). All ammunition fired by this weapon also functions like an Explosive when interacting with Cover for the purposes of carrying damage to targets behind destroyed Cover.

Firing this weapon expends 8 rounds at once. It will not fire if there are less than 8 rounds in the magazine. Each time this weapon makes an Attack, its user must choose if the fired ammunition functions as a Slug or Shell. Whenever this weapon incurs a Critical Injury, the user rolls four times on the Critical Injury table, re-rolling any repeats, and chooses one result for the victim to suffer.

While the user is in the Seriously Wounded or Mortally Wounded Wound State, this weapon overclocks itself, allowing for it to be Reloaded without an Action by sacrificing a Move Action.

Requires BODY 14+ to not reduce the user’s REF, DEX, and MOVE by 2 while wielded and/or held. Finally, possessing this weapon increases the user’s Reputation by 3 when interacting with anyone that’s aware of who this weapon is supposed to belong to.

Fabrication: Leave the slaughterhouse alive. (Cannot be Fabricated, must be gifted or scavenged from Adam Smasher)
Range: Long Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Shotgun Choke, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Shotgun Shell (5d6)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
